facts: National Museum covers Scottish history, natural world, world cultures and technology; general admission free, special exhibits may charge. Location: museum entry.
National Gallery overlooks Princes Street Gardens and holds Renaissance to19thcentury art. Botanic garden highlights Chinese Hillside, Rock Garden and redwoods. Location: respective entries.
Holyroodhouse is at foot of Royal Mile, active royal residence; state apartments and abbey. Location: palace entry.
